subject: Methodology alignment and ownership for ClearHealth POC
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@clearhealth.com>, Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@clearhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Methodology alignment and ownership for ClearHealth POC

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thank you again for the demo today. Quick recap and a suggested experiment design so we can get to a timeboxed POC next week. Please confirm if this matches your expectations and who on your side will own each item.

Goal: validate that Redwood can serve 2 production flows (clinical summarization and patient Q/A) with acceptable accuracy and latency across a 2-week testing window. Success criteria (proposed):
- Clinical summarization: ROUGE-L/semantic match >= 0.78 on our curated set of 120 examples (automated offline) AND stakeholder acceptability >= 85% (manual blind grading)
- Patient Q/A (latency-sensitive): 95th percentile latency < 450ms at 8 RPS simulated load AND answer correctness >= 82% on 200 live shadowed sessions

Evaluation plan (two tracks):
1) Offline evals (week 1): run curated pairs through models to measure automated metrics + manual blind grading on a stratified sample. This gives early signal and lets us iterate prompts and filter out obvious regressions.
2) Online shadow (week 2): Redwood shadow traffic in read-only mode against a small production slice (non-PII subset) to measure real-world latency and end-to-end behavior. We will not write back to your systems.

Ownership (proposed):
- ClearHealth data prep & sample selection: Tom Reeves (ClearHealth)
- Biz acceptance and manual grading coord: Elena Morales (ClearHealth)
- Redwood infra setup & model variant routing: Monica Patel (Redwood)
- Online shadow orchestration & load testing: Rishi Malhotra (Redwood)
- POC project lead / single point of contact: Lauren Bishop (Redwood)

Deliverables and timeline (proposed):
- Tue 7/7: ClearHealth shares sample dataset + redaction checklist (Tom)
- Wed 7/8: Redwood runs baseline offline evals and shares scoring rubric + preliminary prompts (Monica)
- Fri 7/10: Joint manual grading session (asynchronous) results due
- Mon 7/13 - Fri 7/17: Online shadow window (read-only) with daily dashboards
- Mon 7/20: Final results and go/no-go decision

Attached is a scoring rubric template I used with other healthcare pilots — feel free to edit. If this all looks good, confirm owners and I’ll schedule the kickoff and send the GH doc link + HubSpot record.

Best,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Thanks Lauren — this is very helpful and mostly aligns with what we discussed. A couple quick clarifications before I confirm owners: 

1) For the manual blind grading, can Redwood provide the grading UI or a lightweight spreadsheet? We have a small team (3 clinicians) and want an easy workflow.
2) For the online shadow, we must ensure no PHI leaves our VPC. We will provide a de-identified stream and a checklist. Is Redwood able to accept traffic into a private endpoint?

Tom will own the dataset and redaction. He will share the initial sample tomorrow morning. I will coordinate clinical graders and run the asynchronous review.

If the answers to 1/2 are yes, confirm and we’ll call the kickoff good.

—Elena
Director, Clinical Innovation
ClearHealth

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@clearhealth.com>, Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@clearhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Methodology alignment and ownership for ClearHealth POC

Elena — great questions. Short answers: yes and yes. Details below.

1) Manual grading UI: Monica will provision a lightweight grading spreadsheet (Google Sheet) with blind IDs and a simple rubric (Acceptable / Minor issue / Major issue + comment). If you prefer an exported Excel, we can deliver that too. Monica, I’m assigning you to create the sheet and share edit access with Elena + graders today.

2) Private endpoint & PHI: Redwood can accept a de-identified stream into a customer-managed private endpoint (Private deployment flow). We will not persist raw inputs; logs are redacted by default and we will sign an access attestation. Rishi will follow up with the technical checklist and the temporary VPC peering instructions.

Attached: initial scoring rubric (template). I’ve annotated weights in the sheet but leave these editable:
- Accuracy (content fidelity): 50%
- Clinical safety / hallucination checks: 20%
- Readability & brevity: 15%
- Latency / responsiveness (for Q/A flow): 15%

Monica / Rishi: please confirm you can deliver the sheet + tech checklist by EOD. Tom / Elena: if you confirm ownership, I’ll book the kickoff for Wed 7/8 10am PT (30m).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Lauren
